character_images.original_description: This retired watchmaker is an elderly man, around 70 years old, with thin, neatly combed white hair and kind, intelligent eyes that crinkle at the corners. He wears a simple, clean, long-sleeved shirt and a leather apron, his hands showing the fine lines and slight tremor of age but still capable of incredible precision.
character_images.refined_prompt: A close-up, hyper-detailed portrait of an elderly man, a retired watchmaker, around 70 years old, conveying a sense of profound wisdom and gentle patience. His face is lean with a network of fine lines around his kind, intelligent eyes, which are a soft, faded blue-grey, crinkling at the corners in a knowing, subtle smile. His nose is aquiline, and his lips are thin, curved in a perpetually gentle expression. His skin has the subtle texture of age, slightly weathered but healthy, with a few faint age spots, catching the soft, even light. His thin, impeccably neatly combed white hair is parted on the side, framing his dignified face. A hint of his simple, clean, long-sleeved shirt and the rugged texture of a leather apron are visible at the very bottom of the frame, suggesting his profession. The background is pure white, ensuring the focus remains entirely on his expressive facial features and the wisdom they hold. The art style is realistic digital painting, ensuring every minute detail, from the individual strands of his white hair to the delicate lines etched on his face, is rendered with crystal-clear precision in 8K high definition.

character_images.original_description: This pocket watch is an antique, ornate silver timepiece, slightly worn with a beautiful patina. Its cover is intricately engraved with delicate floral patterns, and the white enamel face features elegant Roman numerals and slender blue steel hands. Inside, its delicate brass gears and ruby jewels are visible when open.
character_images.refined_prompt: A macro close-up, hyper-detailed studio shot of a cherished antique pocket watch. The timepiece is crafted from ornate silver, displaying a beautiful, subtle patina that speaks of its age and history. Its intricate cover is lavishly engraved with delicate, flowing floral patterns that are incredibly detailed, catching the light in nuanced ways. The watch is presented slightly open, revealing the pristine white enamel face with elegantly rendered black Roman numerals and slender, vibrant blue steel hands. Beyond the hands, the delicate, polished brass gears and tiny, shimmering ruby jewels of its internal mechanism are visible, meticulously arranged and perfectly clean. Soft, even studio lighting highlights every curve and detail, emphasizing the metallic luster of the silver, the smooth texture of the enamel, and the precise craftsmanship of the internal workings without harsh shadows. The background is pure white, allowing the antique watch to stand out as a singular object of beauty and intricate design. The art style is realistic product photography with digital painting enhancements, ensuring breathtaking clarity and detail in 8K high definition.
